reauth_confirm.description: Sobry refused the API key: it was revoked or has expired. Enter a new key, or leave the field empty to use the public prices.

init.title: Sobry options
init.description: Change the pricing settings or manage the appliances driven by the market price.

add_plan.title: Add an appliance
add_plan.description: Sobry picks the cheapest slots of the day and drives the entity you select.

data.name: Name
data.extra_hours: Extra runtime after the cheap slots
data.power_entity: Keep running while this entity draws power
data.power_threshold: Power above which the appliance keeps running
data.require_complete_data: Wait for the whole window to be priced

data_description.name: Used as the device name, for instance "Water heater".
data_description.target_entity: Left empty, the plan only publishes a binary sensor you can use in your own automations.
data_description.hours: Daily runtime to schedule during the window. Used unless a month or an entity provides one.
data_description.hours_entity: Optional. An input_number, a number or a sensor whose value is a number of hours — a template sensor on the outdoor temperature, the season, the day of the week. It wins over the months and over the runtime above, and replaces the runtime number by a sensor.
data_description.extra_hours: Keeps the appliance running that long after the last selected slot, whatever the price. Useful for a water heater whose temperature you cannot read, to be sure it finished heating.
data_description.power_entity: Optional. A power sensor of the appliance. At the end of a planned window the appliance keeps running while that entity reads above the threshold below — a water heater still drawing power has not finished heating. Watts and kilowatts are both understood.
data_description.power_threshold: Consumption under which the appliance is considered done, in watts. It has to stay below for two minutes before the appliance stops, so a single dip does not cut a heating cycle short.
data_description.power_hold_max: The hold never lasts longer than this after the planned window, whatever the consumption reads. Keeps a stuck sensor from running the appliance all day.
data_description.window_start: Start of the daily window Sobry may pick slots in. Keep the same start and end for a full day.
data_description.window_end: End of the daily window. A window ending before it starts runs overnight.
data_description.max_price: Slots above this price are never selected. Leave empty to always run the requested hours.
data_description.threshold_price: Used by the "below a price threshold" mode only.
data_description.force_price: Optional. Whatever the mode, the window, the runtime or the maximum price, the appliance also runs during every slot priced at or below this value. Set 0 to make the most of free and negative prices, leave empty to disable.
data_description.fallback_start: Fixed schedule used whenever the plan cannot decide: unreachable API, prices not published, or a window it could not fill. Leave both times empty to disable it.
data_description.fallback_end: End of the fixed fallback schedule. An end before the start runs overnight.
data_description.require_complete_data: Hold the appliance off until every price of the window is published, so the cheapest slots are not missed.

monthly_hours_values.title: Runtime per month for {name}
monthly_hours_values.description: Longer in winter, shorter in summer. Leave a month empty to use the runtime configured on the appliance ({hours} h), and set it to 0 to keep the appliance off for that month.

get_cheapest_slots.name: Get the cheapest slots
get_cheapest_slots.description: Returns the cheapest price slots of a daily window, without creating an appliance.

config_entry_id.name: Sobry entry
config_entry_id.description: Sobry configuration entry to read the prices from.

mode.name: Selection mode
mode.description: How the slots are picked inside the window.

extra_hours.name: Extra runtime
extra_hours.description: Hours to keep running after the last selected slot.

window_start.name: Window start
window_start.description: Start of the daily window. Keep the same start and end for a full day.

window_end.name: Window end
window_end.description: End of the daily window. A window ending before it starts runs overnight.

max_price.name: Maximum price
max_price.description: Never select a slot above this price.

threshold_price.name: Price threshold
threshold_price.description: Price under which slots are selected, for the threshold mode.

force_price.name: Always run below
force_price.description: Also select every slot priced at or below this value, whatever the window, the runtime or the maximum price.

require_complete_data.name: Require complete prices
require_complete_data.description: Return nothing until every price of the window is published.
